scenes.narration: A short test of the table scene, one highlighted row at a time.

steps.narration: Version one scores out of ten, while version two scores out of one hundred.
Only version two can resume a review after a worker crash.
Reading down the last column shows what version two adds and what it drops.
Each row compares one feature across every column of the table.
A highlighted column shows how one option behaves in every row.
